question: 按交易所统计 2016 年交易税，列出前 5 名
expected_sql: SELECT ds.ExchangeID AS exchangeid, SUM(ft.Tax) AS total_trade_tax FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades ft JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date dd ON ft.SK_CreateDateID = dd.SK_DateID JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_security ds ON ft.SK_SecurityID = ds.SK_SecurityID WHERE dd.CalendarYearID = 2016 GROUP BY ds.ExchangeID ORDER BY total_trade_tax DESC LIMIT 5

fibo_concepts.note: 交易税以货币金额度量
交易税按证券交易事件统计
